title: Common Type Definitions
description:
AGENTS: before modifying this schema, read AGENTS.md at the repository root.

Shared type definitions used across multiple schemas. Referenced via cross-schema $ref.

vec3.description: 3-component vector (x, y, z) in metres. Each component uses value+unit format per ADR-0008.

quat.description: Unit quaternion (x, y, z, w) for rotation. Defaults to identity (no rotation).

x.description: X component of the quaternion imaginary part. Default 0.0.

y.description: Y component of the quaternion imaginary part. Default 0.0.

z.description: Z component of the quaternion imaginary part. Default 0.0.

w.description: W component (real/scalar part) of the quaternion. Default 1.0 (identity).
